title: [YSQL] Colocation GA: Alter table add primary key(column), drop constraint(PK) not working on colocated tables(new implementation)

labels.name: qa_automation
labels.description: Bugs identified via itest-system, LST, Stress automation or causing automation failures

body:
Jira Link: [DB-5413](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5413)
### Description

- Create a colocated database
- Create a colocated table in this database without a primary key
- Alter the above table and add primary key
**Issue:**
With the new implementation, Colocated tables cannot be altered to add primary key
```
cl_new_implementation=# alter table new_colocated_table_02_alter_pk  add primary key(id);
ERROR:  cannot use 'colocation=true/false' with tablegroup
```

Note: This alter clause works with the old CL implementation.

[DB-5413]: https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5413?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ

**Schema used:**
```
create database cl_new_implementation with colocation=true;
\c cl_new_implementation
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";
CREATE TYPE complex AS (re float8, im float8);
CREATE TYPE e_details AS ENUM ('Email', 'Sms', 'Phone');
CREATE DOMAIN postal_code AS TEXT CHECK(VALUE ~ '^\d{5}$'OR VALUE ~ '^\d{5}-\d{4}$');

CREATE TABLE table_01 (id TEXT, uuid_col uuid DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), name text COLLATE "en_US.utf8", c complex, info json, contact JSONB, arr smallint[], cash money, i inet, m macaddr, i2 serial, i3 bigserial, val smallint, details e_details, age int, collated_data text collate "POSIX",date DATE, n NUMERIC (3, 2),r real, c1 CHAR(1), created_at timestamptz, uuid0 uuid DEFAULT uuid_nil(), uuid1 uuid DEFAULT uuid_generate_v1(), p1 POINT,t1 TIME,ts1 TIMESTAMP,i4 INTERVAL,p2 path, p3 polygon,b box, c2 circle, l line, l1 lseg, a2 text[][], zip postal_code)  WITH (COLOCATION = true);


cl_new_implementation=# alter table table_01 add primary key(id);
ERROR:  cannot use 'colocation=true/false' with tablegroup
```

**Issue exists with drop constraint(primary key) as well**
```
cl_new_implementation=# alter table new_colocated_table_01 DROP CONSTRAINT  new_colocated_table_01_pkey cascade;
NOTICE:  drop cascades to constraint fk_cut_id on table kripa_schema.new_colocated_table_03
ERROR:  cannot use 'colocation=true/false' with tablegroup
cl_new_implementation=#
```
